description: Connects a chat that isn't connected to Replo yet: the chat app asks the user to connect, where they sign in or create a free account and click Allow. Don't call it when Replo tools already work, since the chat is connected. After a sign-in link, call the tool that returned it again instead; that brings up the same prompt. Call this only when the user asks to connect this chat, or when that call returned another sign-in link. Returns who they are; then call list_workspaces.
name: connect_replo_account
title: Connect Replo account
